title: He is probably fine
brief: Selected over Crowd Pier Run because the physical payoff is large and readable without arithmetic. A cartoon zombie is suspended in a chamber with a bomb below it. The fuse/flame is visible, the bomb erupts, and the ragdoll scatters before pieces settle and SPECIMENS goes from 01 to 02. Use ironic understatement about the zombie's predicament, not a player-skill failure or invented revenge/multiplayer story. The failure here is the character's situation; the game interaction succeeds. Preserve a readable fuse setup, the real explosion onset, airborne ragdoll, and clean aftermath with the specimen counter. No recovery is shown or needed. Use one brief deep-fried/grayscale interruption on a real reaction frame, then let the actual result finish the joke. Character/action occupies the middle; upper-left dark wall is free but the upper-right score is evidence. Avoid face/text overlap and keep the end clean.
